newsitem.title: JAPAN: Real estate shares up on hope of LDP win.
newsitem.headline: Real estate shares up on hope of LDP win.

text.p: Shares of real estate firms were higher on Tuesday afternoon, lifted by media reports that the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) may win a majority in the Lower House of parliament in this weekend's election, brokers said.
As of 0508 GMT, the Mitsui Fudosan Co Ltd and Mitsubishi Estate Co Ltd were both 20 yen higher at 1,460 yen and 1,470 yen respectively.
Tokyu Land Corp was up 11 yen at 571 yen and Sumitomo Realty & Development Co Ltd was up 10 yen at 857 yen.
Investors hope that reform of the land taxation system will proceed more swiftly under the supervision of the LDP, brokers said.
